_doc: Manual lineup override applied after rankings_data.json is built but before the HTML artifact is rendered. Use during offseason because Sleeper API returns last-played-week starters, not the user's current planned lineup. ONLY applied when league_id below matches the league the data was built from — a stale override from last season is skipped automatically. To use: set league_id to the current league, update the lineup, bump as_of.
